title: Christmas Breakfast Events  - Save the date
body:
PR1 - Traditions Topic

Dear Parents,
For our next unit of Enquiry we will be exploring different traditions and investigating the question, "How can traditions help us find out about the past?" During this unit, the children will explore what traditions are, how they pass from one generation to another, how they can change over time, and how we can use stories, photographs, and objects as evidence to learn about the past. We know that children often learn most meaningfully when they can connect new ideas to their own lives, experiences, and families. Therefore, we would like to give the children the opportunity to share traditions from their own families.
We would love to welcome a parent, grandparent, or other family member into the classroom as a "family historian" to help share one tradition from your family or culture. There is no expectation that a tradition needs to be connected to a particular country or culture. Every family has traditions, and we want to hear about the ones that matter most to your family. This could be a tradition connected to a celebration, food, music, clothing, a special day, a family activity, story, or simply something your family has done for generations. Of course, we know that families are busy, so there is absolutely no obligation to take part. We will still be exploring lots of traditions in class.
If you are interested in visiting, you would not need to prepare a formal presentation. It would be an informal, show-and-tell-style discussion. We would like the children to have the opportunity to listen, ask questions, and think like historians. If possible, it would be wonderful if you could bring one piece of evidence connected to the tradition, such as a photograph, a book/story, object, or recipe.
If you would like to participate, please send us an email telling us which date you would like to visit. The possible dates and times would be as follows:

body_it:
PR1-PR2-PR3-PR4 - Settimana Francese - Promemoria - Escursione domani

Cari genitori,

Un cordiale promemoria: la nostra escursione a Friburgo è domani!

📍 Punto d'incontro: ore 08:15 sotto l'Angelo Blu alla Stazione Centrale di Zurigo (Zürich HB)
🚆 Partenza del treno: ore 08:32

Gli insegnanti terranno in mano cartelli con i nomi delle loro classi (Primary 1, Primary 2, ecc.) in modo che possiate trovare facilmente l'insegnante di vostro figlio/a. Una volta che vostro figlio/a sarà con il/la suo/a insegnante, vi preghiamo gentilmente di salutarlo/a e di lasciare l'area dell'incontro per aiutarci a evitare sovraffollamento. 🙂

Si prega di assicurarsi che vostro figlio/a porti un piccolo zaino contenente:

*   Un astuccio e/o un libro, se lo desiderano
*   Una borraccia
*   Uno spuntino
*   Una macchina fotografica, se lo desiderano
*   Il pranzo, se vostro figlio/a non ha aderito al pranzo fornito dalla scuola

Si prega di ricordare anche il CAPPELLO TANDEM di vostro figlio/a!

Grazie per il vostro supporto. Non vediamo l'ora di trascorrere una splendida giornata insieme!

title: Primary - Halloween Event
body:
Dear Parents,

On Friday 30th of October****we will be celebrating Halloween with a special Halloween party for Primary classes 1-4.

There will be a costume parade, dancing, spooky decorations, craft activities, and, of course, trick or treating. All activities will take place during the school day (13:45-15:45) and within the school building.

All the children are invited to dress up on this day (please no super scary costumes, or weapons). Children who do not wish to dress up do not need to, and are also welcome to join all the activities.

If you have any questions, please contact Ms Rayment (grayment@ŧandem-ims.ch) or Herr Biehl (

title: Räbeliechtli-Umzug, 3.11.2026
body:
Liebe Eltern

Wir freuen uns sehr darauf, gemeinsam mit den Kindergarten- und Pre-School-Kindern am Dienstag, 3. November 2026, um 17.15 Uhr Räbeliechtli zu feiern. Wir werden den Anlass mit einem kleinen Laternenumzug und einem gemütlichen Beisammensein gestalten.

Damit wir alles gut planen können, bitten wir Sie,

dieses Formular

auszufüllen und uns mitzuteilen, ob Sie und Ihr Kind teilnehmen werden.

Der Anlass findet ausserhalb der regulären Unterrichtszeit statt. Wir treffen uns um 17.15 Uhr auf dem Spielplatz des GZ Riesbach, gegenüber von Tandem.

Bitte füllen Sie das Formular bis diesen Freitag, 25. September 2026, aus, damit wir genügend Zeit haben, alles Notwendige zu organisieren.

Wir freuen uns sehr darauf, diese schöne Tradition gemeinsam mit Ihnen und Ihren Kindern zu feiern!

Freundliche Grüsse

Xenia Faux und Gaby Rayment

Dear parents,

We are very much looking forward to celebrating Räbeliechtli together with the Kindergarten and Pre-School children on Tuesday, 3 November 2026, at 5:15 p.m. We will celebrate with a small lantern procession and a special evening together.

To help us with the planning, please fill out

this form

to let us know whether you and your child will be joining us.

The event will take place outside regular school hours. We will meet at 5:15 p.m. at the playground of GZ Riesbach, opposite Tandem.

Please complete the form by this Friday, 25 September 2026, so that we have enough time to make all the necessary arrangements.
body_it:
Cari genitori,

Siamo molto lieti di celebrare la festa delle "Räbeliechtli" insieme ai bambini dell'asilo e della scuola materna martedì 3 novembre 2026, alle ore 17:15. L'evento sarà caratterizzato da una piccola processione di lanterne e da un piacevole momento conviviale.

Affinché possiamo pianificare al meglio, vi chiediamo di

questo modulo

per farci sapere se voi e vostro figlio/a parteciperete.

L'evento si svolgerà al di fuori dell'orario scolastico regolare. Ci incontreremo alle ore 17:15 presso il parco giochi del GZ Riesbach, di fronte a Tandem.

Vi preghiamo di compilare il modulo entro questo venerdì, 25 settembre 2026, in modo da avere tempo sufficiente per organizzare tutto il necessario.

Siamo molto lieti di celebrare questa bella tradizione insieme a voi e ai vostri figli!

Cordiali saluti,

Xenia Faux e Gaby Rayment
